title: Every JA Joomla quickstart release rebuilt only to tokenize its stylesheets (release-joomla.mjs) has its own template-profiles.json row, equal to the version it was built from but for its note, so the design-templates gate's gallery half is green with a token
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/template-profiles.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, '# fail' and the result of the test 'a release rebuilt only to tokenize its stylesheets has its own row, the same as its source but for the note'.
expect: 'a release rebuilt only to tokenize its stylesheets has its own row, the same as its source but for the note' is ok: every contract under packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts whose manifest says builtFrom.by 'tracy-ds-slot release-joomla.mjs' (17 today: ja-donate 1.0.2, ja-impact 1.0.1, ja-kinetic 1.0.4, ja-mood 1.0.1, ja-morgan 1.0.3 and 1.0.4, ja-nova 1.0.5, ja-phio 1.0.4, ja-podcast 1.0.2, ja-smallbiz 1.0.1, ja-social-ii 1.0.2, ja-spa 1.0.2, ja-space 1.0.3, ja-trip 1.0.4, ja-vega 1.0.4, ja-vogue 1.0.4, ja-voyara 1.0.5) has an exact row whose fields equal its source version's row and whose note starts 'Same logo(s) and content as <source>;'.
'the shipped table is clean against the contracts this tree carries' is ok.
evidence: 10/10/2026: TRACY_RELEASES_GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) tsx scripts/check-design-templates.ts on 977cbb3e6 listed 16 Design inspiration releases with no row of their own (all built by release-joomla.mjs on 09/10); with the rows, the same command prints 'Gallery: 38 releases on Design inspiration, compared with template-profiles.json.' and passes. Each new row was verified stylesheet-only: presentation-lock differs from its source's only in .css hashes, same database dump, identical content map, the release's VERIFICATION.json 0 computed differences.
fence: the template profile table against the contracts release-joomla.mjs seals; not the gallery itself (that needs the private releases token)

tests: a release rebuilt only to tokenize its stylesheets has its own row, the same as its source but for the note
the shipped table is clean against the contracts this tree carries
